hooks.command: echo '=== PROJECT CONTEXT ==='; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); echo "## Branch: $BRANCH"; echo ''; echo '## Uncommitted Changes'; git status --short 2>/dev/null; echo ''; echo '## Recent Activity'; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; echo ''; if [ -f ".claude/branch-context/$BRANCH.md" ]; then echo '## Branch Context'; cat ".claude/branch-context/$BRANCH.md"; fi
